user.title: Add an icon folder
user.description: Pick a folder name. It gets created inside your /config directory. Drop .svg files in it and they show up automatically, no reload needed.

data_description.folder: Letters, numbers, _ and - only. Example: my_icons creates /config/my_icons
data_description.prefix: What you type before the colon, like prefix:icon_name. Leave blank to use the folder name.

error.invalid_folder: Folder name can only use letters, numbers, _ and - (no slashes or spaces).
error.reserved_folder: That folder is used by Home Assistant. Pick a different name.
error.invalid_prefix: Prefix must be lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -.
error.reserved_prefix: That prefix is already used by Home Assistant. Pick a different one.

abort.already_configured: That prefix is already set up.
